title: StowStow Guy Here Again (with the worst trailer ever)
author: PeakyBull
selftext:
Hello everyone! StowStow Guy here. I finally made a trailer-ish video, and I am here to share it with you.

I tried my best to put together a trailer video, and this is how it turned out. I've decided to keep this on my page for now until I can make a better one

I am open to feedback as always

[StowStow Steam page](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4948830/StowStow/)

Thank you!

comments.author: DamnGoodGames
comments.body: I thought it was pretty good!

comments.author: Sylvonara
comments.body:
I've worked in transportation/warehousing for over a decade.. this is a pretty good representation of the work involved, but when the floor got visibly cleaner when being cleaned, I lost it. It seems you've got a bit of fantasy built in to your game! lol.

Nice video.

replies.author: PeakyBull
replies.body: The cleaning was more realistic at first, but after some player feedback, I had to make it simpler and more gamified. Still, I'm glad you liked it.

replies.author: PeakyBull
replies.body: It makes me proud that you like the models I made, Thanks!

replies.author: rapkannibale
replies.body: You made the models and textures? Nice!

replies.author: PeakyBull
replies.body: Yes, I did. Thanks! I am a 3D artist actually
